description: Boulder County Public Works publishes stormwater outfall points. Documented attributes include outfall type, shape, material, elevation, opening count, receiving water, drainage destination, function, ownership and maintenance. The county describes field collection in 2017, supplemented by drainage plans and later field and spatial work. The points and discharge-destination attributes can supply drainage-network outlet locations and receiving-water relationships for simulation. A separately published outlet layer must not be assumed to have identical coverage. The metadata does not establish current discharge rates, pollutant concentrations, complete connectivity or the accuracy of every asset. The service description says county staff update the asset-management inventory as needed. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue. The county overview has inconsistent licence wording; this record preserves the explicit layer-feed licence URL.
